scoring_justification: Tc values are produced by a full DFT+DFPT pipeline that cannot be re-run in the lightweight verifier; comparing the agent's reported Tc against the paper's published values with a tolerance is the only feasible scoring method.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference superconducting Tc values from the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper abstract, main text (Section 2, Results and discussions); values explicitly stated as 4.06 K (pristine), 6.78 K (5% strain), 2.37 K (W-substituted).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly extracted from the paper's main claims without modification.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact numbers reported in the paper and confirmed by the figure descriptions; they are not synthesized or guessed.

outputs.description: Superconducting critical temperature of pristine Mo4/3B2 monolayer.
Superconducting critical temperature of Mo4/3B2 monolayer under +5% biaxial strain.
Superconducting critical temperature of W4/3B2 monolayer.

output_contract.notes: Each Tc value will be compared to the paper-reported value with a hidden tolerance (±0.5 K). Additionally, the three Tc values must satisfy the ordering: Tc(W4/3B2) < Tc(pristine Mo4/3B2) < Tc(strained Mo4/3B2). Full reward requires all three within tolerance and the correct ordering.

steps.description: Check Tc of pristine Mo4/3B2 within 0.5 K of paper value 4.06 K.
Check Tc of strained Mo4/3B2 within 0.5 K of paper value 6.78 K.
Check Tc of W4/3B2 within 0.5 K of paper value 2.37 K.
Verify Tc ordering: W4/3B2 < pristine < strained.
